chunks: They are verily those who exceeded themselves, and the (gods) they invented abandoned them.

key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (demonstrative pronoun pointing to a distant group)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the gods we invented abandoned us?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'self-loss' (khusr al-anfus), where individuals are ruined not merely by external punishment but by their own fabrication of falsehoods that fail to provide intercession. It reflects the theological principle that idols and false gods are powerless entities, emphasizing personal accountability in the absence of divine mediation by these fabricated powers.
